# Detection Latency

Measured from the start of the emulation step. *Telemetry* is the time until the matching event was written on the host; *SIEM alert* is the time until the SIEM raised the alert (scored); *SIEM pipeline* is event → alert: forwarding, indexing and the wait for the scheduled search, which runs every 5 minutes in the RASD Splunk app. SIEM columns need an alert export given to `rasd evidence`.

Targets: ≤ 60 s earns 15 points, ≤ 5 min 10, ≤ 15 min 5 (see [QUALITY_MODEL.md](../docs/QUALITY_MODEL.md)). For a correlation, telemetry latency runs to the event that made it reach its threshold, and its Splunk alert runs once per window, after the window closes.
